item.title: Notify NYC - פלאנירטער וועג פארמאכונג
item.description: א פלאנירטע וועג פארמאכונג דארף פארקומען 10/3 אין דער געגנט פון 2nd Avenue קארנער 54th St to 44th St אין Manhattan. ניצט אלטערנאטיווע וועגן.
item.author: NYCEM [Yiddish]

item.title: Notify NYC - سڑک کی طے شدہ بندش
item.description: 10/3 کو Manhattan میں 2nd Avenue اور 54th St to 44th St کے علاقے میں راستوں کی طے شدہ بندش واقع ہوگی۔ متبادل راستے اختیار کریں۔
item.author: NYCEM [Urdu]

item.title: Notify NYC - Cierre programado de carretera
item.description: Se ha programado un cierre de carretera previsto en el área de 2nd Avenue y 54th St to 44th St en Manhattan el 10/3. Utilice rutas alternativas.
item.author: NYCEM [Spanish]

item.title: Notify NYC - Плановое закрытие дороги
item.description: 10/3 планируется закрытие дороги в районе 2nd Avenue и 54th St to 44th St в Manhattan. Выбирайте другие маршруты.
item.author: NYCEM [Russian]

item.title: Notify NYC - Planowane zamknięcie ulicy
item.description: Przewidywane jest planowe zamknięcie drogi na terenie 2nd Avenue i 54th St to 44th St, Manhattan, w dniu 10/3. Prosimy wybrać alternatywną trasę.
item.author: NYCEM [Polish]

item.title: Notify NYC - 계획된 도로 폐쇄
item.description: Manhattan의 2nd Avenue 및 54th St to 44th St 지역에서 10/3에 도로가 계획에 의해 폐쇄될 예정입니다. 구체적인 위치 및 시간 안내는 NYC.gov/notifynyc를 방문하시거나 3‑1‑1(비디오 릴레이 서비스: 212‑639‑9675, TTY: 212‑504‑4115)번으로 문의하시기 바랍니다.
item.author: NYCEM [Korean]

item.title: Notify NYC - Chiusura di strade
item.description: È stata pianificata la chiusura di una strada nella zona 2nd Avenue e 54th St to 44th St in Manhattan il 10/3. Si consiglia di usare tragitti alternativi.
item.author: NYCEM [Italian]

item.title: Notify NYC - Fèmti Wout Planifye
item.description: Yo prevwa yon fèmti wout planifye ki pou fèt nan zòn 2nd Avenue ak 54th St to 44th St nan Manhattan nan 10/3. Itilize lòt wout.
item.author: NYCEM [Haitian Creole]

item.title: Notify NYC - Fermeture de rue prévue
item.description: Il est prévu que des routes soient fermées à la circulation dans le secteur de 2nd Avenue et 54th St to 44th St, dans le quartier de/du Manhattan, le 10/3. Veuillez emprunter un autre itinéraire.
item.author: NYCEM [French]

item.title: Notify NYC - 計劃的道路封閉
item.description: Manhattan 的 2nd Avenue 和 54th St to 44th St地區按計劃將於於 10/3 進行道路封鎖。請考慮其他路線或提前上路。

item.title: Notify NYC - The Korean Parade - 10/3 (MN)
item.description:
Notification issued 10-02-2026 at 03:00 PM.
As part of the Korean Parade, 6th Avenue will be closed from 38th Street to 27th Street in Manhattan, at the discretion of the NYPD.
Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time. Additional road closures in the surrounding area are possible.
For more information, please visit: on.nyc.gov/traffic

item.title: Notify NYC - Planned Natural Gas Work
item.description:
Notification issued 10-02-2026 at 03:00 PM.
National Grid is scheduled to conduct planned natural gas work tomorrow, 10/3, which may result in an odor of natural gas near 235th Street between 121st Avenue and 128th Avenue in Queens. The work is scheduled to take place between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Please report natural gas emergencies to 9-1-1 if they occur.
